outcome: Colostral macrophage migration inhibitory factor (MIF) concentration
cohort: The study included 44 women, comprising 22 mothers with premature rupture of membranes (PROM) and 22 control mothers without PROM.
finding: Mothers with PROM had significantly higher colostral MIF concentration compared to those without PROM, and this concentration positively correlated with the duration of PROM.
mod_finding: There were no significant differences between the PROM and control groups with regard to the mode of delivery.
cross-section timing: Colostrum was expressed and collected within 72 hours of birth.
birth_weight: Birth weight was measured for the neonates and did not differ significantly between the groups.
gest_age: Neonatal gestational age was measured for the neonates and did not differ significantly between the groups.
